title: #chenjie #wangqiang
analysis_notes: Source file reused from the R2 lane download (1080x1920, 357.9 s; yt-dlp on the Spark now fails on TikTok without impersonation) and re-encoded to 480x854 at ~/studio/refs/horror/7654526047005723937.mp4 (12 MB, kept). No TikTok subtitles; transcript = faster-whisper small (CPU, 2 threads), checked against the burned-in English captions (whisper 'Anksand Gardens' = caption 'Anxin Gardens', 'sent something' = 'sensed something'). Full transcript: research/library/transcripts/7654526047005723937.txt. Content is a translated/dubbed repost of a Chinese 2D 'limited animation' web series (系统/直播 escape-room genre: protagonist trapped in a deadly 'livestream' and only he can see the floating audience comments). The whole picture is horizontally mirrored (all Chinese text reads backwards) and a soft diagonal light-glare sweep passes every few seconds -- classic re-upload anti-duplicate tricks; the English captions are added on top in an unmirrored black band. Track credited as original audio '原創音樂'. One continuous English narrator voice (sounds TTS) reads narration AND all dialogue; whisper VAD found speech for the full runtime (no pauses). Shares (4.2k) are 8% of likes -- strong send-to-friend signal. Story belongs to the source series; do not reuse.
title_pattern: No real title: only two pinyin character-name hashtags (#chenjie #wangqiang = the source animation's protagonists, 陈杰 / 王强). The caption carries zero hook; distribution is entirely by the first-frame + first spoken line. Pattern for us: titles are disposable on TikTok for this format -- put the hook in frame 1 and line 1; at most add a series/character tag for binge discovery.

thumbnail.composition: Auto cover = frame 0. 9:16 canvas, top ~29% black with a single caption line, middle ~43% is the 4:3-ish animation band, bottom ~28% black. In the band: a full-black silhouette of a man centre-left holding a red-handled axe with a white-edged blade, in a dim brown-over-olive corridor; blue vertical sign with white Chinese characters top-right; door frame at right edge.
thumbnail.text: 'A killer broke into my apartment complex.' -- small white sans-serif, centred above the picture (same style as every subtitle). Sign text '单元楼' (mirrored).
thumbnail.colours: Mostly black; muted brown/olive wall; accents of red (axe handle) and royal blue (sign). Low-key, desaturated, with one warm danger accent.
thumbnail.subject_scale_contrast: Faceless silhouette fills ~60% of picture height; the axe blade is the brightest object and points at the viewer. Large black letterbox areas make the small picture feel claustrophobic/peephole-like.
thumbnail.why_it_works: Pure genre signal in one glance (anonymous figure + axe) plus a first-person sentence that reads as the start of a true story ('my apartment complex'). The caption is the hook; the silhouette withholds identity, which the next 5 s exploit (the 'cop' is the killer).

hook.verbatim_0_to_5s: A killer broke into my apartment complex. Management warned everyone to stay safe. Two minutes later, neighbors said he was caught.
hook.verbatim_5_to_14s: Then a police officer knocked on my door. As I reached for the door, words appeared before me. What an idiot! The killer wears a fake uniform to trick residents. This is already his seventh victim.
hook.device: First-person cold open with zero preamble: threat -> official reassurance -> 'resolved' in three 1.7-s sentences (false safety), then the knock at 5.4 s inverts it. At 7 s a second, bigger hook: an impossible omniscient voice (neon floating comments) reveals dramatic irony -- the helper is the killer. Two twists inside 14 s; the viewer now knows more than the neighbours, and stays to see how he escapes. Visual: faceless axe silhouette (frame 0) -> believable chat-UI 'evidence' -> uniformed cop -> glowing neon text box (pattern interrupt).

beats.summary: Killer in the building; management warns; neighbours say he's caught -- three facts in 5 s set a false sense of safety.
A 'police officer' knocks on the narrator's door.
Floating comments (danmaku) appear in mid-air mocking him: the cop is the killer in a fake uniform, 7th victim.
He realises the six 'caught' messages may come from dead neighbours or the killer himself.
Fake cop pounds harder, threatens to break in, radios 'backup' naming Room 802.
Group chat erupts; manager 'Jake' and residents pressure him to open, threaten landlord's key.
He weighs who to trust; arrest beats murder; searches for a weapon.
Comments call him 'the streamer' -- he is the unwilling star of a staged live show; audience says weapons are useless, call someone.
No signal, messages fail; a resident warns of bloody footprints, then management mutes the chat.
Hopelessness; audience comments rate his odds ('doomed', 'there must be a clue').
Remembers previous tenant's hidden phone (1%): real police say it's a whole gang, don't open, and the manager isn't Jake but Donna.
Phone dies; audience mocks him for calling instead of reading texts; last text: 'Do not let them find it.'
Knocking stops, fake cop leaves; crash; doorbell rings.
Linda from 601 (bruised) begs to be let in, says the cop broke her lock.
Comments debate whether Linda is a planted trap; one bets he'll 'eat poop upside down' if the streamer escapes.
He checks her empty hands, lets her in; conceals the black phone and the gang info; probes her story.
Fake cop returns with a hammer; protagonist proposes a lights-off ambush (she hides in bedroom, he waits in kitchen).
A phone rings, cop rushes in, Linda shouts 'he's in the kitchen' -- but he's gone.
He was already in the elevator: Linda's 7th-floor story didn't add up; he decoys the lift to 6 and exits on 5.
Chat explodes; callback to the poop bet and diaper jokes; 'he'll still die'.
Room 601 is really broken into: a corpse in the living room (the real occupant).
Diaper callback; 'is anyone watching the killers?'
Walkie-talkie on the table: gang leader organises the hunt, elevators secured, 'I will make that rat beg for death' -> 'Tap the story below to watch the full ending.'

shot_list.on_screen_text: My blood ran cold.

shot_list.visual_description: Chat UI again, longer neighbour list (re-read as evidence).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Exactly six people claimed the killer had been caught.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist at the door, open-mouthed terror, phone in hand.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Were they already dead? / Did the killer send those messages?

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist leaning to peephole, eyes wide, door left.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I looked through the peephole again. / The officer sensed something and began pounding harder.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop at door, stern, shouting (mouth flaps).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Sir, open the door and cooperate. / Otherwise, I will break it down.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop raises a walkie-talkie to his ear, calling 'backup'.
shot_list.on_screen_text: As he spoke, he called for backup. / Trouble at Building 13, Room 802. Send backup now.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist holding phone near door, worried.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The residents' chat suddenly erupted.

shot_list.visual_description: Chat UI left 2/3, new messages from residents and management ('routine check, do not panic'); protagonist peeking right.
shot_list.on_screen_text: My officer left after hearing about Room 802. / It is only a routine check. Do not panic. / If they break in, you will face questioning.

shot_list.visual_description: Chat UI scrolled: manager messages with crescent-moon avatar pressuring him to open; landlord/key threat.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Open the door if you are home. / The police already got your landlord's number from me. / If you refuse, he will bring them a key. / Stop wasting everyone's time.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist close medium beside door, hollow-eyed fear, holding phone; tiny expression/mouth changes only (long hold under dense narration).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Something felt wrong. / Both of them wanted me to open up. / Jake was suspicious too. / He first reported the killer. / The killer may have already murdered him. / Even arrest was better than being murdered.

shot_list.visual_description: New location: bedroom (sepia wall, grey bed). Protagonist rummages under the bed, cartoon dust-cloud puff.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I searched my room for a weapon. / Then the floating comments refreshed.

shot_list.visual_description: Danmaku box pops in left over the rummaging pose ('主播还是有点智商...').
shot_list.on_screen_text: The streamer realized everyone in the chat is the killer.

shot_list.visual_description: New danmaku box text (weapons are useless, killer has a gun).
shot_list.on_screen_text: He can only buy some time. / Why is he looking for weapons? / The killer has a gun. Nothing will help.

shot_list.visual_description: Third danmaku box ('都是节目效果 / 有没有事打个电话 / 不就知道了').
shot_list.on_screen_text: It is all for entertainment. / Just call someone and confirm it.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist stands facing camera in bedroom, puzzled frown.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Why were they calling me a streamer? / I was confused. / But this was no time to wonder. / The comments reminded me to trust the real police.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist holds phone up to face, eyes bulging, no signal.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I tried calling them, but had no signal. / None of my messages to friends would send either. / Then another message appeared.

shot_list.visual_description: Big phone mock-up (dark bezel) left: chat message from a resident ('do not open, bloody footprints in elevator').
shot_list.on_screen_text: Something is wrong. I tried going out, but found bloody footprints inside the elevator. / Room 802, do not open the door. That man is not a cop.

shot_list.visual_description: Same phone: management posts 'dangerous evidence' notice, then announces all members muted.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Residents, the killer hid extremely dangerous evidence here. / To prevent rumors, everyone is now muted. I will post any new updates.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist faces camera, dot-pupil horror eyes, bedroom.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Our only way to communicate was gone. / My door would eventually be opened. / Was I supposed to wait for death?

shot_list.visual_description: Three successive danmaku boxes (audience: streamer doing well but doomed; 'no livestream is unwinnable, a clue he missed'; 'web of deception').
shot_list.on_screen_text: The streamer is doing pretty well. But he still seems doomed. / No livestream creates an impossible scenario. There must be a clue he missed. / Still, the killers built an impressive web of deception. I doubt the streamer will escape.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist hand on chin, thinking; red curtain behind, bedroom.
shot_list.on_screen_text: So this was a staged livestream. / I began thinking. / Then I remembered a phone hidden under my bed.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist holds out a black brick phone toward camera.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The previous tenant left it. / I offered to mail it, but he refused.

shot_list.visual_description: Black phone screen insert: red low-battery icon '1%'; protagonist at edge.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The phone had almost no battery left.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist holding black phone to ear, stern; long static hold. A yellow jagged 'speech burst' icon flashes at the phone whenever the police dispatcher speaks (e.g. 2:08, 2:26).
shot_list.camera_motion: static, burst icon flashes, occasional glare sweep
shot_list.on_screen_text: I called the police. Hello, I rent Room 802... / Are you inside Building 13, Room 802? All signals are blocked. How did you call us? / ...Your manager is outside with us, but she is not Jake. Her name is Donna, a middle-aged woman.

shot_list.visual_description: Phone lowered, protagonist frowning, battery dead.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The battery failed, and the call disconnected. / The streamer messed up.

shot_list.visual_description: Danmaku box '主播傻了 / 先看短信啊 / 打什么电话'.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Read the texts first. Why call?

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist glancing at the black phone's last text.
shot_list.on_screen_text: In the final seconds, I read, "Do not let them find it."

shot_list.visual_description: Back at the front door; protagonist at peephole, neutral-tense.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The knocking suddenly stopped. / I quietly returned to the peephole.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop, smaller/full body, talking into radio and leaving (seen through peephole framing).
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop spoke into his radio and left.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist at door; expression shifts to hollow dot-pupil terror at the crash and doorbell.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Watching him leave gave me a terrible feeling. / Soon, I heard a huge crash. / Minutes later, someone repeatedly rang my doorbell. / A middle-aged woman now stood outside.

shot_list.visual_description: Linda: middle-aged woman, bob haircut, maroon top, round belly, bruised eye; at the door outside, pleading (mouth flaps, tearful).
shot_list.on_screen_text: I am Linda from Room 601. That cop entered my home. / He smashed my lock with a tool. / After the chat was muted, I hid upstairs. When he entered my home, I ran here. / I only trust you and the resident in Building 4.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist reaches for the door handle, then pauses.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I quickly moved to open the door. / Then a new comment flashed.

shot_list.visual_description: Stack of danmaku boxes, audience debating if Linda is a trap ('不至于吧...', '我感觉十有八九...主播还能逃生我倒立吃粑粑', '换我肯定不开门...').
shot_list.on_screen_text: What if this is another trap? Surely not. / They planted a fake ally in the chat. That would be brutal. / It probably is. If he escapes, I will eat poop upside down. / I would never open it for a stranger. ... This situation is extremely unusual.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist at door, uneasy.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Linda's knocking became much quieter. / She likely feared alerting the fake cop.

shot_list.visual_description: Linda framed alone, hands visible and empty.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I studied Linda carefully. / Her hands were empty.

shot_list.visual_description: Inside the apartment: two-shot (Linda left, protagonist right), alternating with tighter singles of each as they talk (shot-reverse-shot).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Thank you, young man. We are still in danger... / I hid the black phone from her. I also hid that we faced an entire gang. / Who are they, and why are they so vicious? ... / Linda, how long did he take to break your lock? Maybe a dozen hits.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist at peephole.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I heard footsteps and rushed to the peephole.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop outside, head down, approaching with hammer.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop approached slowly, carrying a hammer.

shot_list.visual_description: Linda (left) vs protagonist (right) arguing about barricading.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Quick, barricade the door! / That will not work. It opens outward. / There are two of us, and he may not know.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop swinging hammer at the lock.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop began hammering the lock.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist explains the ambush plan, Linda cropped at left edge.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I will turn off the lights. Hide in the bedroom. I will wait in the kitchen. / When he enters, make some noise inside. When he investigates, I will attack from behind. / This is our only chance. Something unknown must be delaying the real police.

shot_list.visual_description: Linda in the dim bedroom.
shot_list.on_screen_text: After Linda hid, I cut the power.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop hammering door.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop kept hammering the door.

shot_list.visual_description: Kitchen (sink, cabinets), darkened: protagonist gripping a kitchen knife, watching entrance.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I grabbed a knife and watched the entrance. / I left the kitchen door open to avoid suspicion.

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop at door, hand on handle.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Then the hammering stopped. / The door handle began rattling.

shot_list.visual_description: Near-black dark room; yellow ring-burst icon flashes (phone ringing).
shot_list.on_screen_text: Suddenly, a phone rang inside.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist in dim kitchen holding knife.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop rushed past me into the room.

shot_list.visual_description: Linda emerges, pointing/shouting, fake cop's edge visible right.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Linda emerged and shouted at him. He is in the kitchen, get him!

shot_list.visual_description: Fake cop in kitchen turns, bloody streak in hair; nobody there.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The fake cop turned, but I had vanished.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist inside lift (steel-blue walls), hand on chin, smug-calm.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I was already inside the elevator because I never trusted Linda. / She claimed she hid on the seventh floor. The killer had walked from eight down to six. If she hid on seven, he would have found her.

shot_list.visual_description: Elevator floor display reading 6, call buttons panel.
shot_list.on_screen_text: The elevator soon reached the sixth floor.

shot_list.visual_description: Huge elevator button panel; yellow-sleeved hand presses 5.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I selected five, then stepped out.

shot_list.visual_description: Corridor (grey wall, blue dado): protagonist left, neon danmaku boxes stream on the right (audience celebrating, diaper joke, 'he'll still die').
shot_list.camera_motion: box swaps every ~2 s, boxes slide
shot_list.on_screen_text: The comments exploded over my incredible escape. / I cannot believe the streamer escaped that... I wore adult diapers before the stream. / Escaping once means nothing. He will still die. / The comments offered nothing useful.

shot_list.visual_description: Door of room '601' slightly ajar, dark door on grey wall.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Room 601's door was slightly open.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist in corridor, suspicious.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Just as I suspected. / Linda was fake, but they really broke Room 601's door.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist slipping through the doorway into 601.
shot_list.on_screen_text: I slipped inside and froze in shock.

shot_list.visual_description: Corpse of a red-haired woman in yellow blouse/red skirt sprawled on pink floor, eyes closed.
shot_list.on_screen_text: A corpse lay carelessly in the living room.

shot_list.visual_description: Inside 601 (wooden bookshelf bg): protagonist edge-left, danmaku boxes (diaper joke callback, 'is anyone watching the killers', 'their stream ended long ago').
shot_list.on_screen_text: The comments flooded the screen again. Good thing I listened and wore adult diapers. / Is anyone watching the killers? Are they some cult? / Their livestream ended long ago.

shot_list.visual_description: Protagonist pressed by the door, listening.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Then several voices came through nearby. / What happened? How did he escape?

shot_list.visual_description: Black walkie-talkie on a round brown table, pink wall; yellow burst icon flashes beside it each time a villain speaks.
shot_list.on_screen_text: A radio was sitting on the table. / A slippery rat is hiding from us. We are searching. / The elevator first stopped at six... Entering an elevator does not mean riding it... Which one did he choose? / Enough arguing.

shot_list.visual_description: Cutaway: protagonist listening, bookshelf behind.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Another voice silenced them and issued orders.

shot_list.visual_description: Walkie-talkie on table, burst icon flashing with orders; final caption is the CTA.
shot_list.on_screen_text: Ruby, take the elevator down and meet us. / Fake cop, take the other elevator upstairs... Secure both elevators first... / I will make that rat beg for death. / Tap the story below to watch the full ending.

pacing.visual_change_interval_s: ~2-4 s counting expression swaps, danmaku box pop-ins and phone-UI message appends; some long holds of 10-28 s on a single pose under narration (phone call 2:02-2:30, walkie-talkie 5:24-5:58)
pacing.rehook_interval_s: ~15-25 s: twists at 7 (fake cop), 60 (it's a livestream), 84 (bloody footprints), 92 (muted), 114 (hidden phone), 141 (manager is not Jake), 172 (Linda), 190 (trap?), 266 (betrayal), 274 (he was in the elevator), 310 (corpse), 324 (radio), 355 (cliffhanger)
pacing.notes: Wall-to-wall narration at ~3.9 words/s with no pauses; sentences short (avg 6.8 words). Audience-comment interludes (~every 40-60 s) act as a Greek chorus: comic relief, odds-setting, and recap. Ends mid-crisis with a 'Tap the story below' CTA (series funnel). Audio mean -21 dB, peak -3.6 dB.

techniques_worth_copying: Two twists in the first 14 s: false resolution (killer 'caught') then a trusted figure revealed as the threat via an omniscient source.

Diegetic 'floating comments' device: an in-world audience the protagonist can read. It delivers exposition, dramatic irony, odds ('he's doomed'), comic relief (bets, diaper jokes) and recaps without breaking first-person narration. Render as glowing neon boxes with electric borders -- an instantly recognisable pattern interrupt.
Fake-UI evidence: group-chat screens, mute notices, a 1% battery icon -- cheap visuals that make the story feel documentary and give the eye text to read.

Trust ladder: every helper (neighbours, manager, cop, Linda) is suspect; the protagonist wins by spotting a logic slip (Linda's floor story vs the killer's route), then the narration explains the deduction AFTER the payoff (reveal-then-explain).
Running gag callback: 'I'll eat poop upside down if he escapes' set at 3:15, paid off at 4:50 -- rewards retention.
Speaking-object icon: a yellow jagged burst next to a phone/radio signals off-screen voices, so a single narrator voice can read every character.
Limited animation economy: 4 characters, ~7 backgrounds, held poses with expression swaps (normal / dot-pupil horror eyes / narrowed), hard cuts only; story density does the work.

Episodic cliffhanger + CTA ('Tap the story below to watch the full ending') at ~6 min; long runtime with 66x channel-median views shows long-form story reposts can outlier on TikTok when every 15-25 s re-hooks.
Layout: letterboxed picture band with the caption in the black band above it -- caption never covers the art and stays readable.

code_only_remake_requirements.layout: 1080x1920; black background; subtitle text block at y~22-26% (white, ~40 px sans, centred, 1-2 lines, swap per sentence); picture band 1080x~820 at y~29-72%; optional top/bottom series title.
code_only_remake_requirements.characters: SVG puppet rigs for 3-4 flat cel-shaded characters (thick outlines, flat fills, simple shading), each with swappable parts: eyes (normal, wide, dot-pupil horror, narrowed, closed), brows, mouth set for lip flap (3-4 visemes or open/closed toggled by audio amplitude), 2-3 arm poses (holding phone to ear, reaching for handle, hand-on-chin), prop slots (phone, black brick phone, hammer, knife, radio). Blink + 1-2 px idle bob.
code_only_remake_requirements.backgrounds: ~7 flat SVG sets: apartment door w/ peephole (inside and outside variants), bedroom, kitchen, elevator interior + button panel insert, corridor, neighbour's living room w/ bookshelf, table with radio; silhouette 'killer' card for the cold open; corpse reveal card.
code_only_remake_requirements.ui_components: (1) Chat-app screen component (title bar with group name + member count, avatar+name+bubble rows, append/scroll animation, 'all members muted' system message). (2) Danmaku/neon comment box: rounded rect with animated blue electric border (SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap + glow), glowing pink/red text, pop-in scale 0.8->1 with flicker, text swaps. (3) Low-battery insert. (4) Yellow jagged 'voice burst' icon flashing beside phone/radio while off-screen characters speak. (5) Elevator floor display + big button panel with a pressing hand.
code_only_remake_requirements.effects: Hard cuts; occasional push-in on the danmaku box; cartoon dust puff; diagonal light-glare sweep (optional); dim/darken filter for lights-off scenes; screen shake on knocks/hammer hits.
code_only_remake_requirements.audio: One Kokoro/Piper narrator at ~230 wpm (speed ~1.15-1.2) reading narration and dialogue, optionally a second voice for villains/comments; SFX: knock, pounding, hammer on metal, doorbell, phone ring, elevator ding, radio static; low drone bed.
code_only_remake_requirements.data_model: Storyboard JSON per sentence: {text, speaker, scene, characters[{id,pose,eyes,mouth}], overlay(chat|danmaku|insert|burst), sfx}. One sentence = one caption card (~1.8 s); scene changes every 2-4 sentences.
code_only_remake_requirements.original_story_needed: Write our own trapped-in-a-deadly-livestream / omniscient-comments story; do not reuse this plot, characters (Linda, fake cop, Room 802/601) or lines.
